messages:
Samir Patel: FYI customer Bytewave reporting a sudden spike of 503s on hosted inference during streaming calls around 12:42 UTC. They saw p95 jump and a bunch of SDK retries. attaching a minimal log snippet below.

Jenna Liu: thanks Samir — can you paste the exact request headers and SDK version? also did they start a new large batch or change region?

Samir Patel: SDK v1.4.2, single-stream chat request, chunked transfer. Payload size ~180KB, sequence ~1k tokens. headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>, x-region: usam1. No region change.

Samir Patel: logs: ```
INFO 2024-11-10T12:42:33Z request_id=abc123 route=hosted-infer status=502
INFO 2024-11-10T12:42:33Z request_id=abc123 attempt=2 status=503
WARN 2024-11-10T12:42:34Z gateway=ingress timeout_ms=30000 downstream=reset
DEBUG 2024-11-10T12:42:34Z upstream_conn_pool=exhausted
```

Marcus Greene (eng-oncall): looks like ingress is hitting connection pool exhaustion then 503s. @Jenna can you grab the ingress proxy metrics for that host and any recent config pushes? also which exact model were they hitting?

Jenna Liu: they were calling model:redwood-alpha-2. No config pushes on usam1 in last 3 hours. pulling proxy metrics now.

Marcus Greene (eng-oncall): quick mitigation — ask customer to reduce multiplexing to 2 concurrent streams or retry with backoff jitter. also I can temporarily raise connection pool size for their tenant if needed.

Maria Ortiz (billing): note — customer reported duplicate charges during the retry loop. if they do retry heavily, we need to flag for billing credit once we confirm. Please add ticket ref when we have repro.

Samir Patel: customer willing to test reduced concurrency. will try now and report.

support-bot: Ticket INC-2024-8897 created and linked to this thread. Priority: P2.

Jenna Liu: proxy metrics show a spike in active connections from 12:41:58 -> 12:43:10 for tenant bytewave, concurrent connections peaked at 240 (baseline ~40). also saw SYN_RECV count increase.

Marcus Greene (eng-oncall): that explains it — connection storm + streaming large payloads causing pool exhaustion. I'll deploy a short-lived pool bump for tenant bytewave (5m) and watch.

Samir Patel: customer tested with concurrency=2, immediate improvement: no 503s in 5 successful streams. They saw normal throughput.

Maria Ortiz (billing): good, I'll hold a note on INC-2024-8897 for a billing review if they claim duplicate billing from retries.

Jenna Liu: follow-ups: 1) ask customer to upgrade to SDK v1.5.0 (has improved backoff + connection reuse) 2) we'll add guidance to support KB about streaming concurrency limits per model/h2 window. 3) Marcus to propose permanent ingress tuning or quota for bursty tenants.

Marcus Greene (eng-oncall): will open a follow-up infra ticket for autoscaling connection pools per-tenant and a short RFC. Putting a temporary configuration patch into rollout; monitoring metrics.

Samir Patel: customer update — they're OK with SDK upgrade and temporary pool bump. closing for now pending billing check. will reopen if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
